entities.name: Kenzo the Hardhearted
entities.description: A veteran, high-ranking human samurai of Kamigawa in Takeshi Konda's service during the Kami War.

entities.name: Kataki
entities.description: Kami Kenzo prayed to before the war to sharpen swords and harden armor.

entities.name: Yomiji
entities.description: Returned the dead Kenzo to the battlefield.

entities.name: Kami War
entities.description: War during which Kenzo served and died.

events.summary: Kenzo's family dies under unknown circumstances during his service.
events.quote: During his service, his family died under unknown circumstances.

events.summary: Kenzo dies in the war, rejoices to see his family, but Yomiji returns him to the battlefield.
events.quote: Kenzo died during the war and rejoiced to see his family again but was returned to the battlefield by Yomiji .

relations.quote: Kenzo was a veteran, high-ranking samurai in the daimyo Takeshi Konda 's service
